description: Two-alloy IN718 self-improvement loop, arm=maximin, round 5: 25 acquired training cases. Solved in the ds86529 domain (900x600x450+100 um @ 10 um) so they compose with the Ti64 anchor set and are evaluable by base model 86651. TRAINING cases -- the frozen IN718 test set is batch 86840 and is never mixed in. Acquisition: greedy maximin over the full candidate lattice (baseline).
